scope: The original 28 source records in 13 cases added by local commit 6100ece, plus 56 independently reviewed records in nineteen continuation packages. Every complete live readable quotation maps to its declared displayed stream; the original 28 mapping records remain unchanged. Conditional source frames and copied reconstructions retain their explicit captions.
limits: Only the reviewed separator occurrences are omitted. X is the default; p230 uses Y. Protected fields retain internal separator-like labels. Five explicitly listed question marks are prose punctuation; positional unknowns remain mapped.
The three bracketed display letters remain editorial insertions, not recovered plaintext positions.
This verifies ordered presentation labels and preserved layer/frame captions; it does not establish source authenticity, unique repairs or historical identities.
